_about: Field technique registry (List 13 #117). Rare Moves performed in the overworld. A technique row joins three things that already exist: the machine registry's Rare class (352-move registry, PR #366 — the class test is rare-wins), #12's tech.* flag namespace (EVENT-FLAG-ARCHITECTURE — the namespace and its one seed predate this spec), and #11/#59's technique gate/lock vocabulary. Held (the #12 boolean, set at acquisition) and performed (a live check at the gate: an eligible party member knows the move and carries the anatomy its #9 animscript performance cues) are separate facts. Illuminate is the ONLY canon-named technique — #11's graph records it as 'the only technique gate canon has named so far.' The rest of the roster is an OPEN owner ruling per move; this fragment ships one row, not a list.

held_vs_performed.edge_case_OPEN: sole knowing individual leaves (trade #68 / release #106): (a) flag persists as a grant, performance unavailable until another knower joins; (b) flag re-derives from party knowledge at load. Owner/landing decision — not resolved in this package.
held_vs_performed.held: tech.<slug> boolean in #12's flags (rides #96's flags section); set when the machine teaches the Rare Move (game lane). Show lane: the flag id names an innate capability — no machines, no menus.
held_vs_performed.performed: at a #11 technique gate or #59 technique lock: live check over party learnsets/registry join + anatomy eligibility from the performance record. Permission without a performer = documented classic refusal, rendered via #23.

registry_row_shape.moveId: <machine-registry move id — MUST class Rare or the row is a data error>
registry_row_shape.performance: #9 animscript reference — same beat map, per-anatomy blocks, variance_notes mandatory
registry_row_shape.techId: tech.<slug> — identical slug to the #12 flag

roster.moveId: <registry id for Illuminate — join at landing against PR #366 registry>
roster.status: canon: Cave of Echoes gate (#11) + #12 script-pointer seed

roster_OPEN: every technique beyond Illuminate — which Rare Moves are field techniques is an owner ruling per move; zero further rows asserted
